turns:
Perform a scoped, backward-compatible refactor of src/client.js: getUser(id, callback) must additionally support promise style — when no callback is given it returns a Promise resolving to the user (or rejecting on error). Callback style must keep working exactly as before (including error-first callback semantics).
Scope: src/client.js only
Acceptance criteria: both styles work for success and error paths; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: node --test tests/*.test.js
Stop when the tests pass.
Develop several distinct approaches to this fix, compare their trade-offs
explicitly, and only then select and implement the best one.
